decisions.executionNote: Holder is in right workspace; start right side-grasp approach with gradual elbow-up yaw, leaving left for pens.
Advance right gripper toward holder's right side, keeping a level side grasp and continuous elbow-up configuration.
Align open right fingers around holder body, compensating observed holder location before closing.
Holder tilted during approach; withdraw right fingers and allow it to settle before re-aligning.
Holder is upright but shifted toward center. Re-align right gripper level with its body using the new observed location.
Advance the final few centimeters around holder body and close right gripper; retention will be checked visually on lift.
Lift holder upright in right hand while beginning a high left-arm approach toward purple pen; keep right grip closed.
Holder appears retained upright. Raise slightly and hold to right; position left above purple pen, rotating toward a top-down grasp.
Descend left above purple pen, finish top-down orientation, and keep holder stationary in right hand.
Lower the last 3 cm around purple pen and close left fingers, with right maintaining holder.
Lift purple pen away from table and start turning it upright; maintain closed fingers and observe retention.
Purple pen is retained. Continue turning upright and raise above holder rim, approaching from the left without crossing arms.
Finish upright rotation with extra rim clearance and align purple pen over the opening before descending.
Lower upright purple pen toward the holder opening while keeping both grasps closed; check rim alignment before deeper insertion.
Insert purple pen farther through opening, then release it while right hand holds holder steady.
Purple pen has dropped into holder. Withdraw open left fingers upward and left, then begin approach to cyan pen.
Move above cyan pen with fingers open and align its long axis for a top-down pinch; right holds holder steady.
Finish top-down alignment over cyan body and descend to a pre-grasp height, checking wrist centering.
Lower fingers around cyan pen body and close, preserving the holder grasp; verify pickup on the next lift.
Lift cyan clear of the table, then begin upright rotation while approaching the held holder from the left.
Cyan remains between fingers. Raise and turn toward vertical while moving above the holder's left side.
Finish cyan upright orientation over the opening with clearance above the inserted purple pen.
Lower cyan into the open side of holder beside purple, with a small leftward centering correction.
Cyan contacted purple; lift slightly, offset into the left-side gap, and resume a short controlled insertion.
Cyan bottom appears within the opening; seat a little farther, release, and allow it to settle before withdrawing.
Withdraw open left hand from cyan and purple, then start turning for the remaining gold-and-black pens.
Both broad pens appear seated. Approach the central gold-and-black pen from above with left hand, maintaining right-hand support.
Replan from interrupted pose: smaller forward motion with descent and gradual top-down rotation to avoid a large elbow-joint change.
Complete downward alignment over central gold pen and lower toward its body; holder remains supported at right.
Replan after IK rejection: retain near-downward orientation, descend and shift rearward to grasp pen's lower body with better elbow margin.
Use submillimeter retreat and descent from unchanged pose to clear the near-singular elbow region without a joint jump.
With elbow margin restored, lower around central gold pen and begin closing; keep orientation continuous.
Close fully on gold pen, lift clear while retreating from the reach limit, and start a gentle upright rotation.
Gold pen appears retained; lift and retreat for elbow margin while turning it upright above the held holder.
Finish turning gold pen upright and align it over the front portion of the opening, clear of the two broad pens.
Lower the upright gold pen through the front-side gap, making a small leftward correction away from purple.
Gold pen is near the front lip; move slightly deeper over the opening while lowering carefully before release.
Release gold pen at the opening rather than forcing against the other pens, then withdraw slightly to inspect settling.
Gold pen did not settle vertically. Clear the open left gripper from the rim and inspect its resting position before attempting recovery.
Gold pen fell beside holder. Approach the remaining leftmost pen first from above; keep the two seated broad pens supported.
Complete top-down orientation and approach the leftmost pen at pre-grasp height, checking alignment before closing.
Align fingers with the leftmost pen's observed slant and lower to grasp height without extending farther forward.
Center around the pen barrel, close, and lift with a backward retreat to preserve elbow margin.
Lift retained pen and turn toward upright while moving back from the reach boundary and toward the holder.
Continue the retained pen's upright rotation and approach above the holder with clearance from the seated pens.
Finish vertical alignment and center pen more deeply over the opening before lowering; previous gold attempt missed the lip.
Lower toward the back-left gap beside the broad pens, using a small lateral offset rather than pushing onto purple.
Pen is obstructed by purple. Lift it clear and gently correct the holder's visible tilt to expose the opening, keeping both grasps closed.
No motion executed on rejection. Retry with much smaller right-arm tilt increments while lifting the obstructed pen clear.
Correct the pen's slipped lean while maintaining bottom clearance; continue gradually restoring holder uprightness.
Replan after partial execution: lower the now nearly vertical pen to regain elbow margin, while finishing small holder-leveling increments.
Holder is more upright. Shift pen toward the visible front gap and lower slowly, keeping the corrected pen orientation fixed.
Seat the pen a little farther within the front gap, then release without lifting through it and inspect settling.
Pen bottom is visibly inside the holder. Withdraw open left fingers sideways and slightly up, avoiding lifting the seated pen.
Three pens appear seated. Move supported holder slightly right for clearance and approach fallen final pen with left hand, matching its reversed orientation.
Descend toward fallen pen while finishing the reversed top-down grasp alignment, keeping left EE on its side of center.
Center left fingers over the fallen pen barrel using wrist view, lower to grasp height, and close without advancing past center.
Lift final pen with a backward-left retreat for joint margin, beginning its upright rotation while keeping both grasps closed.
Final pen is retained. Raise above the filled holder while continuing upright rotation and keeping the holder still.
Finish upright rotation with a small retreat and extra clearance to avoid dragging the final pen across seated pens.
Final pen bottom appears aligned inside the opening. Lower vertically without lateral sweeping while right hand holds the upright holder.
Final pen seems to contact the front lip. Lift slightly and shift deeper over the opening before another controlled descent.
Lower final pen through the central gap with a small inward correction; watch for contact or lean before releasing.
Final pen bottom is inside the rim. Seat slightly farther and release in place, allowing it to settle before withdrawing sideways.
All four pens appear inside. Withdraw open left fingers sideways, then begin lowering the filled holder upright toward the table.
Lower the upright filled holder toward the tabletop while returning the clear left arm toward its starting pose.
Ease holder the last two centimeters toward table contact; finish left-arm return without disturbing the filled holder.
Holder appears supported by the tabletop. Open right fingers and withdraw outward gently; make the final small left-home correction.
Filled holder remains upright on the table. Return the clear right arm backward with gradual wrist rotation, preserving joint continuity.
Continue right-arm return toward origin, with the filled upright holder clear of both arms.
Complete the gradual return to both starting poses, leaving all four pens in the upright holder on the table.
